title: About Us
aboutText: PT Equityworld Futures (EWF) is committed to being a reliable investment partner in the futures trading sector. With excellent service and continuous expansion, EWF now operates 7 operational offices located in Jakarta (2 offices), Surabaya (2 offices), Semarang, Manado, and Cirebon.
aboutText2: Since its establishment in 2005, PT Equityworld Futures has operated as a licensed futures brokerage company registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency (Bappebti), and as a member of the Jakarta Futures Exchange (JFX) and Indonesia Clearing House (KBI). EWF provides professional, trustworthy, and high-standard services to support clients' investment needs.
ctaText: Join thousands of investors who have entrusted their investments to us.
